name: Gabon

findings.summary: Huawei won the contract to supply active optical equipment for Gabon's national fibre backbone (CAB4 project); in 2017 Huawei trained 17 ANINF, SPIN and Axione engineers on its OptiX OSN 8800/1800 transmission kit and U2000 management system.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole prc: Huawei is the active-equipment vendor. Digital Business Africa page rendered only its headline and date, so contract value, counterparty and funder (World Bank CAB likely) unconfirmed. Tier 4 not 5: installation implied by operator training, but no source confirms Huawei kit is still in service; the ~1,800 km backbone was operated by Axione and passed to a Gabon Fiber concession in Sept 2026 (w.media), vendor unstated.

findings.summary: Ericsson was named sole supplier of Airtel Gabon's new LTE network, supplying RBS 6000 multi-standard radio base stations, microwave upgrades and a core-network transformation, plus professional services.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole third: Ericsson is Swedish. Value undisclosed. Pre-2020 and not checked as still current; whether Airtel Gabon has since added or swapped vendors is unknown. Only one opened source.

findings.local_actor: ST Digital Gabon; Ministry of Digital Economy (MoU on startup hosting)
findings.summary: Cameroon-based operator ST Digital opened a data centre in the Nkok Special Economic Zone near Libreville in July 2026, after breaking ground in August 2025; the digital ministry signed an MoU for discounted startup hosting.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole third: owner-operator is Cameroonian, a foreign non-US non-PRC controller. Capacity, value and IT-equipment vendors undisclosed. Tier III label comes from Developing Telecoms headline; DCD does not confirm the tier rating. still_current true as opening is three months before run date.

findings.financier: Citibank, with Gabonese and US government guarantees (per Gabonreview)
findings.summary: Gabon signed a strategic agreement with US firm Cybastion and Ivorian builder PORTEO for a Libreville data centre (reported as 20MW), plus digital ID and Cisco-backed training; a symbolic foundation stone was later laid.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: no source names the owner-operator; if Cybastion owns and operates it the pole would be us. Date conflict: Gabonreview reports signing 28 Jan 2025, DCD (Feb 2026) says 28 Jan 2026 - possibly a second signing or a DCD error. Tier 2: framework agreement; foundation stone is symbolic, construction start not confirmed. Gov plans a 20MW gas plant to supply it.

findings.summary: Gabon's digital economy minister renewed an MoU with Presight, a G42 subsidiary, in Abu Dhabi to apply AI, big data and analytics to public administration and state services; operational agreements and investment to follow.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole third: Presight is Emirati. Underlying model/compute stack unstated; Presight/G42 work often uses US models and chips, but that is not evidenced here. Described as renewed, implying an earlier MoU not traced.

findings.local_actor: Government of Gabon / Ministry of Digital Economy
findings.summary: Gabon's government and Huawei signed an MoU creating a joint committee to steer priority digital projects, involve local startups and build skills, consolidating the existing connected-schools programme; no value disclosed.
findings.analyst_inference: Layer networks is a reviewer call: the MoU is a cross-layer umbrella with no named project; connected schools is the only cited initiative, assumed connectivity. Followed a meeting between President Oligui Nguema and Huawei about a month earlier.

findings.summary: Huawei's Central Africa chief presented an intelligent video-surveillance offer to the digital economy minister for a planned smart-security project in Greater Libreville (Libreville, Akanda, Owendo); no contract, value or timeline reported.
findings.analyst_inference: Coded tier 1 generously: this is a vendor pitch the government was considering, not a signed statement of intent. No evidence Huawei was selected. Reviewer may prefer to drop it.

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchases surfaced in data-centre or AI searches

models.null_reason: AI search found only the Presight (applications) MoU and a national AI strategy launch; no frontier-model partnership or sovereign model found

power.null_reason: only AI-linked power item is the planned 20MW gas plant for the Cybastion data centre, noted in GAB-004
